name: gdpr_compliance_incident
title: GDPR Data Breach - Unauthorized PII Exposure in Analytics Logs
description: Security audit discovered that user PII (email addresses, IP addresses, device identifiers) is being logged in plaintext to the analytics pipeline. Affected users: approximately 15,000 EU users over the past 90 days. Requires immediate containment, forensic analysis, GDPR Article 33 notification within 72 hours, and systematic remediation of all logging paths.

requirements.description: Identify all code paths that log PII to analytics pipeline
Implement PII scrubbing filter for all log output channels
Purge affected PII data from analytics storage within 48 hours
Generate GDPR Article 33 breach notification report
Implement automated PII detection scanner for CI pipeline
Add data classification labels to all model properties
Create user notification template for GDPR Article 34 communication
Implement audit trail for all PII access with retention policy
PII scrubbing must add no more than 5ms latency per log entry
All remediation must be completed within 30 days of discovery

constraints: Must comply with GDPR Articles 33 and 34 notification timelines
No PII may be retained in any non-encrypted storage
Remediation must not disrupt production service availability
All changes require security team sign-off
